content.title: What stores are open on Easter 2026? Walmart, ShopRite, CVS and more
content.text: Easter Sunday celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ, with many out at Easter mass, hopping over to nearby Easter eggs hunts and visiting with friends and family. As a significant religious holiday in the Christian faith, many stores and restaurants close, although some stores open for Easter 2026.As for retailers, Walmart will be open on Easter Sunday, though Target will be closed on Easter. Grocery stores like ShopRite are open, but others like Costco close on Easter. Several fast-food chains, like McDonald's, will be open, and coffee shops likes like Starbucks and Dunkin' open on Easter Sunday.Here's what's going to be open on Easter Sunday, and what will be closed on Easter 2026.What stores are open on Easter 2026?Here are the stores open on Easter Sunday, April 5:Walmart (open 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; check local store hours)ShopRite (open 6 a.m. to 8 p.m., but hours vary widely by location)Home Depot (open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.; check local store hours)CVS (open 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; check local store hours)Walgreens (open 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.; check local store hours)Old Navy (open 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.; check local store hours)Tractor Supply (open 9 a.m. to 7 p.m.; check local store hours)Family Dollar (open 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.; check local store hours)PetSmart (open 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.; check local store hours)Cabela's/Bass Pro Shops (open 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.; check local store hours)What stores are closed on Easter 2026?These stores are closed on Easter Sunday 2026, April 5:TargetCostcoLowe'sKohl'sBest BuyFive BelowBurlingtonDollar TreeUltaSephoraTJ Maxx, Marshalls, and HomeGoodsPetcoAldiMichaelsSam's ClubMacy'sHobby LobbyDick's Sporting GoodsMacy'sNordstrom/Nordstrom RackIs Easter tomorrow?Yes. Easter is Sunday, April 5, 2026.Is today Holy Saturday?Yes. Today, Saturday, April 4, 2026, is Holy Saturday, observed between Good Friday and Easter Sunday. It commemorates the time Jesus is believed to have been in the tomb after crucifixion. It's sometimes called "The Great Sabbath," often considered a quiet and reflective day ahead of Easter celebrations beginning after sunset.Is Easter always on a Sunday?Yes. Easter is celebrated on Easter Sunday, commemorating the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Easter falls on the first Sunday after the first full moon, on or after March 21. Easter can fall as early as March 22 and as late as April 25. But it's always on a Sunday.Easter 2025 was on April 20, 2025. Easter 2027 will be on March 28.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based news reporter covering trending news with USA TODAY Network's Mid-Atlantic Connect Team. She covers health and other news in the Northeast, including New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia.
